Epic dark-fantasy digital painting in a square composition, viewed slightly from below. A party of five armored heroes stands on jagged black volcanic rock split by glowing orange lava cracks, surrounded by dragons, elemental magic, storm clouds, and a burning gothic city.

He grips an enormous two-handed sword angled diagonally from his waist toward the upper-right corner; the blade glows intensely violet-magenta, wrapped in purple lightning and shedding sparkling energy.

Directly behind him, a pale, dark-haired male mage in ornate black, navy, and gold armor holds a tall staff topped with a brilliant blue crystal and concentric circular arcane symbols. His raised right hand cradles a bright orange fireball, scattering sparks against the dark clouds.

On the left midground, a dark-skinned male swordsman in dark armor and a forest-green cloak crouches defensively, extending a silver sword horizontally toward the left. Below him, a red-haired female warrior-mage in black armor stands inside a translucent spherical shield of churning blue water and ice, holding a long icy blue spear angled down-right. Waves and frozen spray curl around the sphere.

On the right, a pale white-haired female fighter in revealing black, spiked armor kneels on a rocky ledge. Her hair blows strongly to the right. She raises a large black double-bladed axe overhead while extending a long dagger or short sword down-right.

A colossal black dragon head fills the left side, with layered horned scales, a luminous blue eye, and an open mouth packed with long sharp teeth; brilliant blue frost or energy pours from its jaws. A second huge dark dragon looms on the right, lit from beneath by orange fire, with its red-orange eye and jagged teeth visible. A smaller winged dragon flies near the top center-right against turbulent gray-black storm clouds.

The background shifts from icy electric blues on the left to fiery oranges on the right. Tall gothic towers and a distant castle silhouette rise through flames and smoke along the right horizon. Large curved black spikes protrude from the lower-right foreground. Highly detailed, cinematic, hyper-rendered fantasy concept art with glossy metal, sharp ornamental armor, dramatic rim lighting, dense particles, sparks, magical glow, and strong blue-orange-purple contrast.
